target: reconfirmation of 2026-06-25 contact security audit findings

evidence: functions/api/contact.ts parses request.formData() at line 65 before any Content-Length guard.
Server validation at lines 78-82 checks only presence/email format/message minimum; no server max lengths are enforced.
Client maxlength attributes exist in all contact forms, but those are bypassable by direct POST.
functions/api/contact.ts line 94 types Siteverify response as { success?: boolean } and line 95 checks only success.
Cloudflare docs include action/hostname response checks as enhanced validation and recommend checking additional fields when specified.
All six forms render Turnstile and catch failed /api/contact submissions, then re-enable the submit button.
Repo search found no turnstile.reset, expired-callback, error-callback, or timeout-callback usage.
Cloudflare docs state tokens are single-use, expire after 300 seconds, and used/expired tokens must be replaced with fresh challenges.
All six forms branch on if (!tsEl) and simulate success instead of POSTing /api/contact.
The Turnstile widget only renders when services.turnstileSitekey is truthy.
Therefore a production build missing PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITEKEY will show a success state without sending the message.
.env.example instructs use of PUBLIC_WEB3FORMS_KEY for the Web3Forms access key.
Astro docs state PUBLIC_ variables are made available to client-side code.
Current dist search found no PUBLIC_WEB3FORMS_KEY/access_key leak, so this is a naming/config footgun rather than an active leak today.
